mechanism: Risedronate requires intact GI mucosa and specific absorption conditions; norethindrone may alter GI motility and affect risedronate bioavailability, while estrogen/progestin can influence bone metabolism and bisphosphonate efficacy.
action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; monitor for reduced risedronate efficacy; consider alternative contraception if bone loss is a concern, or ensure adequate calcium/vitamin D supplementation.
